rationale: UAFIC association portal is a durable hub for UA fintech/payments actors, events and member directory.
Single-edition programme page on fintechua.org; covered by monitoring the parent portal.
Standalone awards portal whose recurring shortlists name UA fintech/payments vendors and deployments.
FinAwards nominee lists are a recurring near-census of UA consumer financial brands and digital deployments.
Most payments-specific UA award; annual shortlists surface acquirers, PSPs and terminal/software vendors.
Finclub bank-of-the-year ranking plus forum stream give recurring vendor and payments-volume signals.
Recurring UA banking-IT forum organiser; agendas and partner blocks name integrators and software vendors.
AmCham events calendar continuously surfaces international payments vendors and their UA partners.
Second UA banking association is in scope but URL verification failed; re-check liveness before approving.
NBU financial-inclusion forum microsite; regulator-platformed partners signal policy-aligned payments opportunities.
NBU events host is a discovery root for regulator gatherings, though research-conference content is only weakly commercial.
Retail/FMCG expo organiser whose exhibitor and partner tiers catch payment-acceptance and retail-tech vendors.
Venue calendar catches low-web-presence trade shows including banking equipment and retail tech.
Offshore exhibitor directory to mine once for UA self-service/cash-automation vendors and their competitor set.
Recurring small UA fintech/payments B2B forum where new entrants first buy visibility.
Minfin project subdomain aggregates FinYear agendas and award nominee announcements across UA consumer finance.
Vertical UAFIC conference subdomain; siblings on fintechua.org make parent monitoring sufficient.
Third-party global event aggregator of unclear credibility and licensing; useful only as a cross-check.
Annual fintech/retail-boundary conference matching payment-acceptance and in-store banking vendor positioning.
Self-published bank award rosters are back-fill evidence to mine once, not a continuous signal producer.
